notes.title: Kalahari's End Public Beta Launch
notes.content:
The public beta for Kalahari's End is in full swing! Here is a showcase of some new features since the end of the previous beta!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44874021/5b805d7286598573226fc87bccfcbe9da6e57796.png

You can find the newly released food preparation trailer here,
[previewyoutube=_3amqg6Ou2s;full][/previewyoutube]

Note: You can participate in this playtest by visiting the Steam store page for Kalahari's End and looking for the "Join the Kalahari's End Playtest" section.

Beta Update v0.1.4 Patch notes for players with existing beta copies.

New Stuff,
- New material, Raw clay.
- New material, Refined clay.
- New structure, Clay mixing table. (Used to craft refined clay.)
- New item, Clay pot. (Can be crafted by clicking on refined clay in the inventory satchel.)
- New harvestable object, Ant mound. (Can be chopped using an axe to obtain raw clay.)
- New structure, Bamboo water pump. (Used to pump water from deep water sources.)
- New structure, Bamboo water pipe. (Used to transport water from pumps to desired areas.)
(Place the end of a pipe section above crop planters and water holders to fill them up.)
- New structure, Water holder.
- New animal, Spurfowl. 
- New meat type, Fowl. (Similar to other meat types but cannot be dried.)
- New structure, Stick bird trap.
- New structure, Bamboo bird trap.
- New food item, Bamboo shoot. (Can be found growing near any area that has bamboo.)
- New food item, Yucca fruit. (Can be found growing on large yucca plants.)
- Yucca plants can now be grown in crop planters using yucca fruit.
- Bamboo can now be grown in crop planters using bamboo shoots.
- New insect, Dung beetle.
- New insect, Fireflies will now start to fly near water sources at night.
- New insect, Dragonflies will now start to fly near water sources during the day.
- New insect, Butterflies will now group in certain areas.
- New insect, Moths will now start to rise from the grass in the afternoon.
- New item, Animal droppings. (Used as a basic fertilizer in crop planters)
- New item, Dung ball. (Used as a potent fertilizer in crop planters)
- Players can now press [G] while using a campfire to add a stone ring which will make the fire burn longer.
- Added new section in build menu to craft basic items.
- Added new sounds for various in game features.

Fixes,
- Fixed load screen not waiting for all player built structures to spawn before starting game.
- Fixed render issues with stone collision particles.
- Fixed flashlight not rendering correctly over water.
- Fixed campfire flames not rendering correctly over water.
- Fixed torch flames not rendering correctly over water.
- Fixed new players starting with ambience volume muted.
- Fixed resolution option not showing in pause menu.
- Fixed shadow settings not working in main menu.
- Fixed terrain settings not working in main menu.
- Fixed main menu graphics not syncing correctly.
- Fixed lock sensitivity button not working in main menu.
- Fixed terrain quality not loading correctly.
- Fixed audio settings not loading properly.
- Fixed crops using more water than necessary. 
- Fixed crops causing framerate issues.
- Fixed beds causing framerate issues.

Changes,
- Animals harvested by the player will now disappear.
- Reworked main menu style.
- Rope hangers can now store 30 rope instead of 21.
- Reworked warthog material.
- Increased max player stamina.
- Stamina will now regenerate quicker.
- Stamina will now decrease slower.
- Placed blueprints will now have a darker color than ones being placed to easily differentiate between each other.
- Optimized acacia tree rendering from far distances.
- Reworked acacia tree leaf material.
- Reworked and improved textures for multiple cliffs and stones.
- Optimized volumetric fog rendering.
- Optimized shadow rendering on multiple objects.
- Bloom can no longer be disabled completely.
- Optimized bloom rendering.
- Anti-Aliasing presets can now be modified in the graphics settings.
- Anti-Aliasing quality can now be modified in the graphics settings.
- Shadow update rate can now be modified in the graphics settings.
- Shadow distance can now be modified in the graphics settings.
- Render distance can now be modified in the graphics settings.
- Texture quality can now be decreased another level.
- Reworked pause menu layout.
- Optimized grass rendering.
- Reduced shadow cascade count.
- Optimized shadow distance.
- Optimized shadow rendering.
- Optimized main menu rendering.
- Improved quality on multiple ambient sounds.
- Improved quality on multiple animal sounds.
- Reduced zebra volume.
- Optimized fruit spawning.
- Optimized crop planter rendering.
- Optimized animal AI.
- Improved general particle quality.

Note: The graphics setting for players with existing games have been reset to default values.

notes.title: Kalahari's End Beta Update v0.1.4
notes.content:
Beta Update v0.1.4 Patch Notes!

New Stuff,
- New plant type, Red fire stick plant. (Has a chance of causing skin rash on contact depending on how much armor the player has equipped and will not cause damage if player has 4 pieces of any armor equipped.)
- New plant type, Green fire stick plant. (Does not cause skin rash.)
- New player effect, Skin rash. (Caused by toxic plants.)
- Significantly increased map size. (An entrance to the new map area can be found near the abandoned bar.)
- New biome, Red fire stick forest.
- New biome, Green fire stick forest.
- New point of interest, Abandoned metal research base.
- New axe, Camping axe. (Equipped by default for now. The old axe has been disabled until weapon switching becomes available.)
- Palm trees can now be harvested using an axe.
- Swamp trees can now be harvested using an axe.
- Palm saplings can now be harvested using an axe.
- Camel thorn bushes can now be harvested using an axe.
- New option to modify terrain quality in the graphics settings. (To avoid issues it is recommended that players with existing saves manually switch to high terrain quality.)

Fixes,
- Fixed players getting stuck on custom walls.
- Fixed collision issues with custom walls.
- Fixed players could not cancel single log walls.
- Fixed structures not allowing the player to destroy.
- Fixed interaction issues with blueprints.
- Fixed player could not harvest fish or snake while food satchel had enough space.
- Fixed players could harvest fish or snake with full food satchel.
- Fixed meat drying racks not saving stored items.
- Fixed basic wall type not saving.
- Fixed collecting log while holding bow blocked player from dropping logs.
- Fixed snake hitbox not detecting arrows while in deep water.
- Fixed campfire input prompts disappearing when clicking.
- Fixed player moving too fast when canceling slide jump mid-air.
- Fixed 5x5 basic foundations won't cancel.
- Fixed player could spam rest position to enter and exit.
- Fixed holding [E] while using a campfire with a filled pot automatically consumed water.
- Fixed dying while holding tool froze arm animator.
- Fixed sliding into water increased speed.
- Fixed player could drink while swimming.
- Fixed water drink popup showing while swimming.
- Fixed arrows not colliding with palm trees correctly.
- Fixed bush chop sound not working with volume sliders.
- Fixed falling from high point did not knock player down.
- Fixed some audio sources did not scale with volume settings.
- Fixed log carts teleporting to incorrect position.

Changes,
- Players now have a small chance of not being envenomated by snake bites depending on how much armor they currently have equipped.
- Collecting logs will now instantly free hands.
- Optimized shadow rendering.
- Optimized volumetric fog rendering.
- Optimized volumetric cloud rendering.
- Modified the color of some plants.
- Optimized bamboo group rendering.
- Optimized tall bamboo rendering.
- Modified some map areas.
- Updated arm log material.
- Updated arm bamboo log material.
- Pots now have a chance to spawn near the old truck.
- Reduced low fall damage height.
- Increased high fall damage height.

notes.title: Kalahari's End Beta Update v0.1.3
notes.content:
Beta Update v0.1.3 Patch Notes!

New Stuff,
- New structure, Stick Meat drying rack. 
- New structure, Bamboo Meat drying rack. 
- New food item, Dried meat.
- New food item, Dried crab.
- New food item, Dried fish fillet.
- New structure, Basic plank wall. (Snaps to foundations.)
- New structure, Basic plank windowed wall. (Can be built by pressing [R] on a plank wall blueprint)
- New structure, Basic plank door wall. (Can be built by pressing [R] on a plank wall blueprint)
- Players can now destroy built structures by holding [Q] while looking at the structure.
- New log wall type, Windowed wall. (Can be built by pressing [R] on a 1x5 Log wall blueprint)
- New log wall type, Door wall. (Can be built by pressing [R] on a 1x5 Log wall blueprint)

Fixes,
- Fixed player could not clean crab.
- Fixed some blueprint names showing incorrectly in build menu.
- Fixed player could not place blueprints when canceling fish trap blueprint.
- Fixed player could hide bow while aiming. 
- Fixed player could interact with campfire while using log cart.
- Fixed campfire fuel displaying incorrectly when empty.
- Fixed player could collect bamboo log while holding acacia log.
- Fixed player could collect acacia log while holding bamboo log.

Changes,
- Improved large stone cliff texture quality.
- Updated input prompts for some blueprints.

notes.title: Kalahari's End Beta Update v0.1.2
notes.content:
Beta Update v0.1.2 Patch Notes!

New Stuff,
- New material, Bamboo sticks. 
- New material, Bamboo logs.
- New structure, Bamboo log holder.
- New structure, Bamboo stick holder.
- New structure, Bamboo torch.
- New structure, Stick Torch.
- New structure, Bamboo chair.
- New structure, Plank chair.
- New structure, Bamboo fish trap.
- New structure, Stick fish trap.
- New weather system, Clouds have a chance to be sparse, average, cloudy or stormy. The higher cloud intensity the slower body temperature will go up.
- New calendar system to determine current year, date, temperature and weather.
- New weather notification which will popup at 9AM with information on daily weather.
- Storm clouds will now begin to form when it starts to rain.
- Rain drops will now make a sound when falling on a lit campfire.
- New interface for crafting menu to improve readability.

Fixes,
- Fixed crocodile body rotation entering incorrect offset when swimming.
- Fixed stat popup displaying before game is finished loading.
- Fixed arm animations getting stuck when entering water while holding an item.
- Fixed arm animations getting stuck when climbing while holding an item.
- Fixed logs not displaying correctly when collected very quickly from log cart.
- General optimization changes.
- Fixed blueprints selecting when player was not looking at them.
- Fixed player could drink lake water while using build menu.
- Fixed player could drink lake water while holding axe.
- Fixed player could drink lake water while holding knife.

Changes,
- Dew collectors will slowly fill up when it is cloudy.
- Log carts can now store wood logs OR bamboo logs.
- Eating dirty crabs will no longer give the player parasites and clean crabs will now provide more nutrients.
- Reduced rain drop intensity.
- Increased rain volume.
- Decreased snake hiss frequency.
- Pressing pause while viewing survival guide will now close it before pausing.
- Bamboo trees can now be chopped using an axe to obtain up to 3 bamboo logs.
- Bamboo bushes can now be chopped using an axe to obtain up to 8 bamboo sticks.
- Equipping water bottle will now automatically close inventory.
- Opening food satchel will now automatically hide water bottle.
- Players can now exit rest positions (Chairs, Beds, etc.) By jumping or crouching.

notes.title: Kalahari's End Beta Update v0.1.1
notes.content:
Beta Update v0.1.1 Patch Notes!

New Stuff,
- New structure, Log cart. (Used to transport up to 15 logs. Can be built by accessing the storage section of the craft menu)
- New food type, Meat Stew. Made by placing meat and water in a pot near a campfire.
- Players can now cook meat in a pot.
- New point of interest, Abandoned pickup truck.
- New arrow pointer to assist in custom foundation placement.
- New 'Unstuck' button in pause menu intended for when the player is stuck and cannot move. (Will teleport the player to their most recent bed or the starting position.)

Fixes,
- Fixed eating an item quickly after equipping it froze animator.
- Fixed food items displaying in hands even after hiding.
- Fixed player not exiting rest position correctly.
- Fixed custom foundations not flipping to the left side. 
- Fixed 1x1 size custom foundation required 2 clicks to place.
- Fixed cooking smoke suddenly stopping when finished cooking an item.
- Fixed right clicking on placed blueprint canceled it.
- Fixed campfire pots caused steam when empty.
- Fixed killed animals making sounds.
- Fixed looted items showing in hands while holding logs.
- Fixed opening build menu dropped hand item.
- Fixed warthog footstep dust not displaying.
- Fixed animal footstep sounds not playing.
- Fixed animal footstep sound not working with volume sliders in settings.

Changes
- Dew collectors now only require two yucca leaves to fill a pot.
- Campfire input prompts will now hide while cooking any meat item.
- Clean crab popup will no longer display while holding an already clean crab.
- Fill bottle popup will no longer display while holding a full bottle.
- Increased rain possibility on every tick.
- Increased minimum and maximum rain duration.
- Snakes will make more noise when the player gets closer.
- Increased warthog angular speed.
- Increased zebra angular speed.

notes.title: Kalahari's End Beta Update v0.1.0
notes.content:
Beta Update v0.1.0 Patch Notes!

New Stuff, 
- New popup to inform players that their inventory is full when collecting an item.
- New popup to show players how to cancel blueprint.

Fixes, 
- Fixed player could spam left click while cooking to freeze animator.
- Fixed animator getting stuck when moving directly after cooking item.
- Fixed players could cook spoiled food items.
- Fixed players could cook already cooked items to restore spoil time.
- Fixed interact popup showing in some menus.
- Fixed one of the load screen tips had typo.
- Fixed axe chop sound on bushes and trees was not working with effects volume settings.
- Fixed player could open inventory on death animation.
- Fixed audio clipping when looting an item directly after chopping a bush or tree.
- Fixed players could collect food items when food satchel was full.
- Fixed players could use inventory items while harvesting animals.
- Fixed campfire input guide obstructing inventory UI.
- Fixed toggle crosshair button not saving.
- Fixed mouse input popup on pot not displaying correctly.

Changes
- Player will now automatically exit fire when an item is cooked.
- Inventory no longer requires players to hold button. (Players can select whether to toggle or hold inventory button in the gameplay settings.)
- Updated key-bind menu display inputs.
- Pressing [Escape] or [Q] will now exit crafting and inventory menus.
- Players can now tap [Q] to cancel blueprint instead of having to hold the button down.

notes.title: Kalahari's End Beta Update v0.09
notes.content:
Beta Update v0.0.9 Patch Notes!

New Stuff, 
- New structure, Short steps. (Snaps to foundations.)
- New structure, Long steps. (Intended for multi-story building. Snaps to foundations and also works as a roof.)
- Added crosshair which players can toggle in the gameplay settings menu.
- New popup to help players see that they can interact with something.

Fixes, 
- Fixed zebra audio not playing.
- Fixed player could select campfire when not looking at it.
- Fixed radio destroyed volume not working with effects slider.
- Fixed holding [Left Click] on inventory menu returned to basic inventory.
- Fixed render issues with some small ponds.
- Fixed players getting stuck on swamp trees.
- Fixed opening food satchel while running with bow freezes animator.
- Fixed opening build menu canceled some structures.

Changes
- Loot boxes will now always have loot.
- All food items will now take much longer to spoil.
- Significantly decreased foundation building cost.
- Campfire use no longer requires player to hold [E] and only requires quick tap.
- Bed no longer requires player to hold [E] and only requires quick tap.
- Toolboxes and lockers no longer requires player to hold [E] and only requires quick tap.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44874021/c1afa1247629e8c82f2a99d835acc27fc60d866f.png

notes.title: Kalahari's End Beta Update v0.08
notes.content:
Beta Update v0.0.8 Patch Notes!

New Stuff, 
- New animal, Common warthog.
- Logs can now be chopped using an axe to get sticks.
- Sleep menu will now display current time.
- New option to automatically wake up in the morning.
- New arrow pointer to show which direction placed blueprints will face.

Fixes, 
- Fixed custom pieces not placing.
- Fixed free hand button not working.
- Fixed dropping rawhide did not work. (There is no collectable rawhide item at this time so this will basically just destroy it.)
- Fixed shadow flickering issues.
- Fixed arrows floating in the air after hitting an animal.
- Fixed tutorial not detecting progress properly.
- Fixed tutorial not saving properly.
- Fixed basic foundation not placing on confirmation.
- Fixed holding 'Light fire' kept lighting and extinguishing fire.
- Fixed holding 'Add fuel' did not cancel input keys.
- Fixed players could harvest animals with full inventory.
- Fixed players could collect leather with full inventory.
- Fixed players could collect items with full inventory.
- Fixed tanning rack displaying 2 items collected when only 1 was collected.
- Fixed blueprint not canceling when opening craft menu.

Changes
- Increased base walk speed.
- Changed custom piece input to be more accessible.
- Switched cancel placement from [Left Mouse] to [Q]
- Increased passive animal spawn rate.
- Significantly increased hostile animal spawn rate. (Snake spawn rate remains the same)
- Changed all mouse input prompts to be more clear.
- Free hands option will now hide the water bottle.
- Ability (Co2) Button switched from [Q] to [Z] so that it no longer conflicts with cancel.
- Reduced maximum rain duration.
- Reduced chance of rain on every tick.
- Updated sleep menu input prompts.
- Updated bed input prompts.
- Updated campfire input prompts.
- Animals are not as easily scared off anymore.
- Reduced blueprint rotation speed.
- Basic foundations now use [R] and [F] to rotate.
- Placed blueprints will now copy the rotation of previously placed blueprints.
- Opening craft menu will now hide handheld item.

Content which will be added in the next update, THIS CONTENT IS NOT AVAILABLE IN THIS PATCH
- Basic steps, Will snap to foundations. 
- Long steps, Will snap to foundations. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44874021/c1afa1247629e8c82f2a99d835acc27fc60d866f.png
